name: Bella Terra
description: Bella Terra is an open-air lifestyle shopping destination in Huntington Beach featuring a dynamic mix of popular retailers, dining destinations, and entertainment options. The center offers a vibrant Southern California shopping experience with walkable streets, outdoor plazas, and a welcoming atmosphere that attracts locals and visitors alike. With convenient access from Edinger Avenue and proximity to the beach, Bella Terra combines shopping convenience with coastal lifestyle charm.
summary: Bella Terra is an open-air lifestyle center in Huntington Beach offering premier shopping, dining, and entertainment in a walkable coastal California setting.
